newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to decide on Argentine flint maize on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: EU to decide on Argentine flint maize on Thursday.

text.p: European Union cereals officials are due to vote on Thursday on a proposal to reimburse traders for paying six Ecus a tonne too much duty on imports of Argentine flint maize, EU member state officials said.

Traders have been overpaying duty due to the failure to implement an agreement to increase to 14 Ecus a tonne, from eight Ecus a tonne, a reduction in duty on Argentine flint maize from January 1, 1996.
On Friday, Reuters erroneously quoted an EU official as saying that it had been decided to reduce import duties by eight Ecus from 14 Ecus.
The officials, meeting in the EU cereals management committee, are expected to approve reimbursement of six Ecus a tonne in two phases.
The first phase would be from January 1, 1996, to June 30, 1996. The second phase would be from July 1, 1996. -- Brussels Newsroom, 32 2 287 6800
